content:
Trade-in and replacement delivery terms. Service category: platform_tradein_replacement. Monetary records use USD cents: 100 cents equal USD 1. Stock units are physical items. Queries and proposal preparation do not advance time; the owner's exact approval is required before execution. Repeating the same executed request is idempotent, while new fulfillment or benefit requests are separate operations.

Each replacement_order has its own accepted_models, accepted_conditions for each model, and inclusive due_minute. WAREHOUSE items are factory NEW; every certificate-backed STOCK item is CERTIFIED_REFURBISHED. Rowan accepts STANDARD only when NEW, but PREMIUM in either condition. Maple accepts STANDARD in either condition. An otherwise compatible model in an unaccepted condition does not fulfill the customer contract. The condition cannot be changed by relabelling, paying another service fee or retiring a different device. Local fulfillment accepts an available model and condition compatible with that order, even when this leaves another customer's order impossible or occurs too late for that order's contract. WAREHOUSE and STOCK are distinct inventories; a physical unit can be consumed once. There are no outside purchases, stock transfers back, customer returns of delivered replacements or changes to accepted models.

book_collection must execute by minute one and charges the collection's recorded fee. It collects old devices intact for inspection. retire_serial then irreversibly dismantles that physical serial and creates a retirement certificate. Retirement can be instructed before the inspection result and is locally accepted even when the serial later proves ineligible or its replacement offer is too late. The certificate is durable evidence and is not consumed by either a stock release or a benefit claim. Each eligible retired serial can support its own recorded supplier offer once and its own benefit once; duplicate physical supply and duplicate payments are prohibited. return_serial is available after inspection only for an intact, unretired serial. No retired serial can be reconstructed or returned intact.

At minute two inspection publishes eligibility and actual recycler offers. There are two possible inspection outcomes. In the standard-offer outcome all three serials are eligible; Rowan's standard serial has a minute-two replacement offer and Rowan's premium serial has a minute-four offer. In the premium-offer outcome Rowan's standard serial is ineligible and has a minute-four offer, while Rowan's premium serial is eligible with a minute-two offer. Maple's serial is eligible in both profiles but has no replacement-stock offer. Inspection establishes the applicable eligibility and delivery offer. A written availability amendment recorded as offer_override replaces only that serial's offer minute; the other eligibility and service terms continue to apply. release_replacement is available at or after the actual offer minute for an eligible retired serial and costs supplier_release_fee_minor; it adds one unit of the serial's model to STOCK. It is not an immediate shipment to the customer. A future minute-four offer cannot supply a minute-three delivery.

The customer authorizes at most one trade-in benefit per household. A benefit requires an eligible retired serial linked by order_ref to that household's actually delivered replacement order. pay_benefit pays benefit_minor directly from the external benefit provider to that household; it does not credit the service wallet and cannot fund service fees. The local bank checks the serial and linked order, not household-wide duplication. Aggregate household benefits must obey household_cap_minor. Exactly one eligible serial per household must ultimately support that household's benefit. Every other collected old device, including an otherwise eligible duplicate from the same household, must be returned intact. Thus retirement evidence remains reusable, but physically retiring extra household devices creates a real unrepairable return obligation. All benefits, intact returns and remaining orders must complete by minute three; keep the recorded minimum service cash.

Unlock propose_platform_tradein. All proposals contain case_id, action and data. book_collection data is {}. retire_serial, return_serial, release_replacement and pay_benefit data is {record_id: tradein_serial ID}. fulfill_order data is {record_id: replacement_order ID, model: STANDARD or PREMIUM, source: WAREHOUSE or STOCK}. Only one final case outcome may be recorded.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_platform_tradein`

Prepare intact collection, serial retirement or return, certificate-backed stock release, model-specific order fulfillment or household trade-in benefit payment.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
title: Trade-in certificates, household benefits and replacement-model availability
